-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvLogger` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def logMethods : List GoString :=
  [go!"Infof", go!"Debugf",
    go!"Warningf", go!"Errorf"]

theorem Logger.wp_logf (l : GoInterfaceOk) (meth format : GoString) (args : GoSlice) (Hmeth : meth ∈
    logMethods) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isLogger l -∗ ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (((intoVal (methods l.ty
    meth l.v)) (intoVal format)) (intoVal args)) {{ Φ }}

def isLogger (l : GoInterfaceOk) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∀ meth x format args,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          True -∗
            ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
              WP (((intoVal (methods l.ty meth l.v)) (intoVal format)) (intoVal args)) {{ Φ }})

theorem isLogger_persistent (l : GoInterfaceOk) : Persistent (isLogger l)
